findings.finding: Any existing per-group evidence directory is treated as a started HTTP service and requires runner-process-group.json plus http/isolation/cleanup.json. A frozen cold gate failure creates protocol/cache/wrapper but launches no service, so supported partial delivery cannot pass protection with this valid no-service terminal.
findings.required_repair: Before service-only files, inspect wrapper terminal. Validate the exact no-service cold-gate shape (runner_rc/monitor_rc None, no service PID, failed cold gate, nonzero owner exit), record no service started, and skip nonexistent service-unit cleanup. Do not silently waive active/unknown failures.

findings.finding: Target-file and DEST checks do not reject intermediate groups/harness symlink directories; writing a nonexisting child could escape the intended archive subtree.
findings.required_repair: During preflight for every target, reject symlink ancestors through destination and require resolved target containment before any mutation; preserve collision/no-overwrite behavior.

not_findings: Model audit uses only 228 metadata records plus config/index content; payload/ref content not opened.
Existing failed outcome return codes remain visible and do not become performance acceptance.
Partial archive declares accepted requests separately from unknown attempted and missing groups; archive is not acceptance; default off/54GB unknown remain explicit.
